title: Claim and run a Site Change
description: Atomically claims the exact base commit and queues one isolated Codex workspace run. No shell command, executable path, remote URL, Git ref, branch name, provider option, or credential is caller-selectable. The service owns its bounded site_content_v1 prompt and verification policy.

instruction.description: Sensitive authoring input. Responses and ordinary audit payloads expose only instruction_digest.
